Class OffscreenButtons.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.OffscreenButtons.Builder
Enclosing class:
OffscreenButtons
public static final class OffscreenButtons.Builder extends Object
Fluent live button configuration. Keep one builder per independently styled control. Suppliers and painters are borrowed, not copied; later edits affect controls built from this object. Every method runs on the client thread.

    • modular

      public <T> T modular()
      Adapts this same style and action to ModularUI without requiring it for ordinary GuiScreen buttons. Assign the result to a ButtonWidget variable; continue using its normal position, size and tooltip methods.
      Type Parameters:
      T - ModularUI ButtonWidget target type
      Returns:
      a new ModularUI ButtonWidget
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if ModularUI is not installed

    • draw

      public void draw(int x, int y, int width, int height, OffscreenButtons.State state)
      Paints this configuration at framework-supplied coordinates, supporting custom frameworks without adapters. The helper restores driver attributes, matrices and Minecraft's GL cache, including when a painter throws. Custom painters must not switch the framebuffer or GL context.
      Parameters:
      x - left edge
      y - top edge
      width - width
      height - height
      state - current visual state
